{{Disambig|Hazmat}}

==Enemies==
'''Hazmat''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Elite Hazmat]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 24 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Elite Hazmat/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Hazmat]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 17 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode
**[[Fallen Hazmat/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Hazmat]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 17 in [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] and [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Hazmat/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Hazardous]], internally named '''Polluted Hazmat''' and formerly named '''Hazmat''', an enemy that first appears on Wave 3 in [[Polluted Wasteland II]].
*[[Molten Hazmat]], a [[PVP]] Molten arena exclusive enemy that can only be sent after Wave 15
